statusLine.command: input=$(cat); absdir=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir // .cwd // ""'); case "$absdir" in "$HOME"*) dir="~${absdir#"$HOME"}";; *) dir="$absdir";; esac; branch=$(git -C "$absdir" symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$branch" ] && git -C "$absdir" rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then branch='-'; fi; model=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.model.id // "?"'); effort=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.effort.level // ""'); ctx=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r 'if .context_window.used_percentage != null then .context_window.used_percentage elif ((.context_window.total_input_tokens // 0) > 0 and (.context_window.context_window_size // 0) > 0) then (.context_window.total_input_tokens / .context_window.context_window_size * 100) else 0 end'); h5=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.rate_limits.five_hour.used_percentage // 0'); d7=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.rate_limits.seven_day.used_percentage // 0'); e=$(printf '\033'); R="${e}[0m"; D="${e}[2m"; C1="${e}[36m"; C2="${e}[32m"; C3="${e}[35m"; C4="${e}[33m"; C5="${e}[34m"; C6="${e}[31m"; sep=" ${D}|${R} "; out="${C1}${dir}${R}"; [ -n "$branch" ] && out="${out}${sep}${C2}${branch}${R}"; out="${out}${sep}${C3}${model}${R}"; [ -n "$effort" ] && out="${out}${sep}${C4}${effort}${R}"; out="${out}${sep}${C5}$(printf '%.0f' "$ctx")% ctx${R}"; out="${out}${sep}${C6}$(printf '%.0f' "$h5")% 5h${R}${sep}${C6}$(printf '%.0f' "$d7")% 7d${R}"; printf '%s' "$out"
